correctness.rationale: The revised complete RESULT derives the cube boundary covariance Sigma=(d+2)/(3d)I, exact kernel 1+a_d x.y, and strict vertex norming by opposite-sign kernel patches on facets. At a vertex W=epsilon+S_(d-1); integrating Irwin–Hall positive-part density gives boundary norm a_d[1+B_(d-1)(1+1/a_d)+B_(d-1)(1-1/a_d)]. Volume 1+6B_d(1/3) is explicitly acknowledged prior. Radial R with E R=d/(d+1), ER²=d/(d+2), plus a clipped first moment q_d proves strict separation and a O(d^-1) remainder; CLT uniform integrability yields scaled gap sqrt(6/pi). Independent exact rational B_n sums for d2..9 confirmed d2:5/3 vs 233/108 and d3:94/45 vs415/162.
